title: Fast ref lookup + token reduction (compact list tools + compact show)
summary: Drastic token cut for agent ref search: compact list tools (phase-list/task-list), fix feature-list UUID→ref, compact show by default with full=true opt-in, directive.
description:
Problem: agent burns 10-32K tokens to find an entity by ref — reads .planner/phases/*.json files (each = full phase + all task descriptions), or calls planner-plan-get full=true (~32K tokens for 81 task descriptions on this project). planner-task-show returns a compact 1-line text BUT also dumps structuredContent:{task,phase} (full object with description+statusLog+checklist) to the LLM. planner-feature-list emits raw UUIDs (not refs), so the agent can't use list output as refs and falls back to reading files.

Measured on this project (19 phases, 81 tasks): compact ref+title+status index of ALL entities = ~1.9K tokens (17x smaller than full plan-get).

Solution (single-source, zero drift — all tools compute-on-demand from authoritative files, no persisted index):
1. Core: no storage changes. (Optional: a compact serializer in refs.ts for the list rows.)
2. plan-mcp + pi-adapter: add planner-phase-list + planner-task-list (compact rows: F00x/P00x/T00x · shortId — title (status), filterable by feature/status). Fix planner-feature-list to emit F00x · shortId — name (status; N phases, M tasks) instead of UUID.
3. plan-mcp + pi-adapter: make planner-task-show/phase-show/feature-show compact by default (drop structuredContent full-object dump; keep the 1-line text). Add full=true flag to opt into description+statusLog for that ONE entity.
4. Directive: context block (pi-adapter startup resume protocol) + AGENTS.md rule 9 addendum: "to find an entity → list tool (compact); to act → pass ref directly to the action tool; to read a description → show with full=true; NEVER read .planner/*.json files or call plan-get full=true to locate an entity."

Files: packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, packages/plan-core/src/refs.ts (optional helper), AGENTS.md, CHECKLIST.md.

Non-goals: renaming .planner files (rejected — mutability/lookup cost); persisted index/mirror (rejected — second source of truth, drift risk).

tasks.title: plan-mcp: add phase-list + task-list compact, fix feature-list, compact show with full flag
tasks.description:
In packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:

1. planner-feature-list: change output line from `${feature.id} — ${feature.name} (status; N phases, M tasks)` to `${formatFeatureRef(feature.number)}${feature.shortId ? ` · ${feature.shortId}`:""} — ${feature.name} (${feature.status}; ${featurePhases.length} phases, ${taskCount} tasks)`. Drop structuredContent {features} (full objects) — return text only. Add optional `featureRef` filter param.

2. New planner-phase-list: compact rows. For each phase (optionally filtered by featureRef): `${formatPhaseRef(phase.number, featureNumberOfPhase(phase, features))}${phase.shortId?` · ${phase.shortId}`:""} — ${phase.title} (${phase.status}; ${phase.tasks.length} tasks) [F${pad(feature.number)}]`. Optional filters: featureRef, status. Text only, no structuredContent dump.

3. New planner-task-list: compact rows. For each task across all phases (optionally filtered by featureRef/phaseRef/status): `${taskCompositeRef(task, phase, features)}${task.shortId?` · ${task.shortId}`:""} — ${task.title} (${task.status})`. Text only.

4. planner-task-show / planner-phase-show / planner-feature-show: drop structuredContent full-object dump (the {task:found.task, phase} etc). Keep the compact 1-line text as default. Add `full: z.boolean().optional()` param — when true, append the entity description (+ statusLog for task) to the text. When false (default), just the 1-line identity.

Keep all existing ref-acceptance (findTaskByRef etc). These are additive + a show-output change.

---
**Completion summary:**
plan-mcp (packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts) fast-ref-lookup:

1. Fixed planner-feature-list: was emitting raw UUID (`${feature.id}`) + dumping structuredContent {features}. Now emits `F00x · shortId — name (status; N phases, M tasks)`, text-only (no structuredContent), + optional featureRef filter.

2. Added planner-phase-list: compact rows `F00x/P00x · shortId — title (status; N tasks) [F00x]`, filters: featureRef, status. Text-only.

3. Added planner-task-list: compact rows `F00x/P00x/T00x · shortId — title (status)`, filters: featureRef, phaseRef, status. Text-only.

4. Compacted the 3 show tools (feature-show, phase-show, task-show): dropped structuredContent full-object dumps ({feature,phases}/{phase}/{task,phase}); added `full: z.boolean().optional()` flag — default returns 1-line identity (saves tokens), full=true appends description (+ statusLog for tasks).

Tool descriptions advertise "do NOT read .planner/ files or planner-plan-get full=true to find entities".

Type fix: optional-param handlers use `({ featureRef })` not `({ featureRef } = {})` (the ={} default broke SDK ShapeOutput typing — matches existing handoff tools pattern).

Verified: pnpm -r build + pnpm check clean. Smoke-test on this .planner (7 features/20 phases/85 tasks): feature-list=160 tok, phase-list=522 tok, task-list=1962 tok, ALL=2644 tok vs plan-get full=true ~32000 tok → 12x reduction. dist has 2 new list tools, `if(!full)` compact guards, 0 structuredContent dumps.

Implementation note: edit tool silently failed on em-dash/middot lines (memory [ebab28b2e966] confirmed); used line-index node scripts (write tool for exact bytes, \u2014/\u00b7 escapes, ASCII-fragment matching) — 9/9 show-handler edits + feature-list block splice succeeded.

tasks.title: pi-adapter: mirror list tools + compact show + directive in context block
tasks.description:
Mirror the plan-mcp changes in packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:
1. Fix planner-feature-list notify/output to emit F00x · shortId (not UUID) — both the feature-list tool output AND the feature-create/feature-update notifies (L1461, L1527 area) that still emit ${feature.id}.
2. Add planner-phase-list + planner-task-list tools (same compact format as plan-mcp). Reuse the shared helpers from @agent-plan/core (formatFeatureRef, formatPhaseRef, taskCompositeRef, featureNumberOfPhase).
3. Make planner-task-show/phase-show/feature-show compact by default + full=true opt-in (drop structuredContent full-object).
4. Add the directive to the startup resume protocol / context block: "To find an entity by ref → call planner-phase-list/planner-task-list (compact). To act → pass the ref directly to the action tool (task-start/complete/update/etc accept F00x/P00x/T00x, bare P00x/T00x, shortId, UUID, title). To read a description → call show with full=true. NEVER read .planner/*.json files or call planner-plan-get full=true to locate an entity — it burns ~32K tokens."

---
**Completion summary:**
pi-adapter (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts) mirrored fast-ref-lookup:

1. feature_list: was emitting UUID `${f.id}` + dumping details:{features}. Now emits `F00x · shortId — name (status; N phases, M tasks)`, details:{} (no full-object dump), + optional featureRef filter (F00x/shortId/UUID/name).

2. phase_list: was emitting UUID + details:{phases}, filtered by featureId(UUID). Now emits `F00x/P00x · shortId — title (status; N tasks) [F00x]`, details:{}, filters: featureRef (accepts ref) + status.

3. task_list: was emitting UUID + details:{tasks: phase.tasks}, required phaseId. Now emits `F00x/P00x/T00x · shortId — title (status)`, details:{}, filters: featureRef + phaseRef (accepts refs via findPhaseByRef) + status. Omit all → lists every task.

4. feature_get/phase_get/task_get: were emitting UUID + dumping full object in details. Now compact identity by default (details:{}), + `full: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean)` flag — full=true appends description (+ statusLog for task). task_get now uses findTaskByRef (accepts bare T00x/composite/shortId/UUID/title) instead of UUID-only lookup.

5. Fixed feature-create/feature-update notifies (L1464/L1530): emit `F00x · shortId — name` instead of UUID.

6. Added `pad(n)` helper after statusIcon (used by task composite formatting).

7. Updated MANDATORY OPERATIONAL PROTOCOL rule 6 (context block, L3704): was outdated ("T00x is per-phase AMBIGUOUS"). Now: numbers GLOBALLY unique, bare P00x/T00x valid; FAST LOOKUP directive — use feature_list/phase_list/task_list (compact ~2K tokens) to find entities, do NOT read .planner/*.json or plan_get full=true (~32K tokens); pass ref directly to action tools; use task_get/phase_get/feature_get with full=true for one entity's description.

Verified: pnpm -r build + pnpm check clean. dist has 2 list tools, 3 full flags, 0 UUID feature-list/notify. Smoke: 2643 tokens for whole plan (12x reduction vs plan-get full=true ~32K).

NOTE: 2 remaining `details: phase` dumps are in phase_create/phase_update ACTION confirms (not the search path) — left as-is (out of scope).

tasks.title: AGENTS.md rule 9 addendum + CHECKLIST: efficient ref lookup directive
tasks.description:
Update AGENTS.md rule 9 (Comunicazione e Riferimenti) with a "Ricerca efﬁciente / risparmio token" addendum:
- To find an entity by ref: call planner-phase-list / planner-task-list (compact, ~1.9K tokens for the whole plan) — do NOT read .planner/*.json files or call planner-plan-get full=true (~32K tokens) to locate an entity.
- To act on an entity: pass the ref (F00x/P00x/T00x, bare P00x/T00x, shortId, UUID, title) directly to the action tool (task-start/complete/update/phase-update/etc) — no pre-read needed.
- To read a description: call the show tool with full=true for that ONE entity.
- One-line summary of measured impact (17x token reduction for discovery).

Also update CHECKLIST.md with the fast-ref-lookup work entry.

---
**Completion summary:**
AGENTS.md rule 9 addendum "Ricerca efficiente (risparmio token)" added: trovare→feature_list/phase_list/task_list (compact ~2K token), agire→passa ref al tool di azione, descrizione→task_get/phase_get/feature_get con full=true, divieto di leggere .planner/*.json o plan_get full=true (~32K token) per localizzare un'entità. Single-source, zero drift.

CHECKLIST.md: appended full "Fast ref lookup + token reduction" entry (F006/P002) with problem, solution (plan-mcp + pi-adapter + directive), measured 12x reduction, validation, pending release step.
